# 津波被災割合の妥当性チェック

集落単位で求めた津波被災割合の妥当性を市町村単位に換算してチェックする(津波被災していない集落も含めてチェックを行う。こうしないと換算時に誤差が生じる)。

まず、市町村単位の農地面積・被災農地面積に換算したデータフレームをつくる。

```{r}
# 市町村単位のデータフレームに変換
gis_df <- df |>
  mutate(
    city_code = substr(area_code, 1, 3)
  ) |>
  distinct(
    KEY,
    city_code,
    farmland_total_ha,
    tsunami_total_ha
  ) |>
  mutate(
    city_code = case_when(
      city_code %in% c("101", "102", "103", "104", "105") ~ "100",
      TRUE ~ city_code
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(city_code) |>
  summarise(
    gis_farmland_total =
      sum(farmland_total_ha, na.rm = TRUE),

    gis_tsunami_farmland_total =
      sum(tsunami_total_ha, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
# 市町村名列を追加
gis_df <- gis_df |>
  mutate(
    city_name = case_when(
      city_code == "100" ~ "仙台市",
      city_code == "202" ~ "石巻市",
      city_code == "203" ~ "塩竈市",
      city_code == "205" ~ "気仙沼市",
      city_code == "207" ~ "名取市",
      city_code == "209" ~ "多賀城市",
      city_code == "211" ~ "岩沼市",
      city_code == "214" ~ "東松島市",
      city_code == "361" ~ "亘理町",
      city_code == "362" ~ "山元町",
      city_code == "401" ~ "松島町",
      city_code == "404" ~ "七ヶ浜町",
      city_code == "406" ~ "利府町",
      city_code == "581" ~ "女川町",
      city_code == "606" ~ "南三陸町",
      # 以下続ける
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# 農水省公表の農地面積及び津波被災農地面積
maff_data <- tibble(
  city_name = c(
    "気仙沼市",
    "南三陸町",

    "女川町",

  # 農水省公式資料記載の各市町村の農地面積

```


```{r}
comparison_village <- gis_df |>
  inner_join(maff_data, by = "city_name") |>
  mutate(
    gis_damage_share =
      gis_tsunami_farmland_total / gis_farmland_total,

    official_damage_share =
      official_tsunami_farmland / official_farmland_total,

    damage_share_diff =
      gis_damage_share - official_damage_share,

    farmland_ratio =
      gis_farmland_total / official_farmland_total,

    tsunami_farmland_diff =
      gis_tsunami_farmland_total - official_tsunami_farmland
  )


comparison_village |>
  summarise(
    cor_area = cor(
      gis_tsunami_farmland_total,
      official_tsunami_farmland,
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    cor_share = cor(
      gis_damage_share,
      official_damage_share,
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    mae_share = mean(
      abs(damage_share_diff),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

```

津波被災面積、津波被災割合ともに相関が高い。MAEも大きく問題があるわけではない。


```{r}
comparison_village |>
  mutate(
    farmland_ratio =
      gis_farmland_total / official_farmland_total,

    tsunami_ratio =
      if_else(
        official_tsunami_farmland > 0,
        gis_tsunami_farmland_total /
          official_tsunami_farmland,
        NA_real_
      )
  ) |>
  select(
    city_name,
    farmland_ratio,
    tsunami_ratio,
    gis_damage_share,
    official_damage_share,
    damage_share_diff
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(damage_share_diff)))



```

各地域の誤差傾向。小規模地域で誤差が多いようにもみえるが、必ずしもそうでもない（次グラフ参照）。

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

comparison_village |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = official_farmland_total,
    y = abs(damage_share_diff),
    label = city_name
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "農地面積（ha、対数目盛）",
    y = "被災割合の絶対誤差"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
GISでの農地面積が公表値とずれている地域は誤差が大きくなる傾向がある。

とりあえず、致命的なレベルの誤差はないと判断して、津波被災割合を今後の分析に用いることにする。
